'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian summer counteroffensive]]
****[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] strike the strategic [[Antonivka Road Bridge]] in [[Kherson Oblast]] using its [[M142 HIMARS]] missile system, causing severe damage to the bridge and preventing vehicles from crossing. Ukraine also claims to have destroyed a Russian [[ammunition dump|ammunition depot]], artillery and other military equipment in the region, killing 51 [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian troops]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-moscow-6a927f75ac4fdb854999d65139b9bd80 (AP)]
***[[Ukraine]] says that [[Russia]] has launched [[cruise missile]] strikes at targets along its [[Black Sea]] coast, including at [[Odesa]] and [[Mykolaiv]] port infrastructure. [https://www.voanews.com/a/ukraine-says-russian-strikes-hit-areas-along-black-sea/6673997.html (Voice of America)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[Anti-MONUSCO protests]]
***Fifteen people are killed and 50 others are injured as [[MONUSCO|UN peacekeepers]] open fire at an anti-[[United Nations]] protest in [[Goma]], [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/26/un-peacekeepers-troops-shoot-two-protesters-dead-in-goma-drc (Al Jazeera)]
***Three UN peacekeepers and seven civilians are killed during an attack on a [[MONUSCO]] base by protesters in [[Butembo]], Democratic Republic of the Congo. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/26/un-peacekeepers-troops-shoot-two-protesters-dead-in-goma-drc (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Afghanistan]], [[Sanctions against Afghanistan]]
**[[Afghanistan]] and [[United States]] officials exchange proposals for the release of billions of [[United States dollar|dollars]] from the [[Da Afghanistan Bank|Afghan central bank]] reserves held abroad into a [[trust fund]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/7/26/us-and-taliban-exchange-proposals-for-release-of-funds-report (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Economy of Bangladesh]]
**[[Bangladesh]] announces that it will request a $4.5 billion loan from the [[International Monetary Fund]] for balance of payment and budgetary requirements, as well as [[climate change management]] activities. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/26/bangladesh-seeks-4-5bn-imf-loan-as-forex-reserves-shrink-report (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russia in the European energy sector]]
**[[European Union]] energy ministers approve legislation to lower demand for gas by some member countries by 15% from August until March 2023. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-europe-natural-gas-31a7bda2e8498859ef46557d7103eddb (AP)]
*[[Transport in Croatia]]
**[[Croatia]] opens the {{convert|2404|m|ft}} long [[Pelješac Bridge]] that spans the sea channel between [[Komarna]] and [[Pelješac]] and connects the country's southeastern [[semi-exclave]] to the rest of the country, bypassing [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]'s short coastal strip in the municipality of [[Neum]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/26/croatia-opens-long-awaited-bridge-bypassing-bosnia (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[July 2022 United States floods]]
**Flooding occurs in parts of [[St. Louis]], [[Missouri]], United States, killing at least one person, as the city reports a daily rainfall record of more than {{cvt|7|in|mm}}. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/07/26/weather/st-louis-flash-floods/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2022 Gujarat toxic liquor deaths]]
**At least 40 people have died and 50 others have become ill after consuming illegally brewed alcohol in [[Gujarat]], [[India]]. Several suspected [[rum-running|bootleggers]] have been detained in connection with the deaths, according to [[Gujarat Police]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/toxic-liquor-deaths-in-gujarat-reach-40-nearly-50-still-in-hospital-cops-3197677 (NDTV)] [https://apnews.com/article/india-ahmedabad-ce0d7c54e2e78bc930628fecfb6ab651 (AP)]
*The [[Met Office]] confirms that [[England]] is experiencing its worst [[drought]] [[1976 British Isles heat wave|since 1976]], particularly in [[South East England]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-62303330 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***The first case of [[monkeypox]] in a pregnant woman in the United States is reported. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/monkeypox-pregnant-woman-baby-cases/ (CBS News)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Federated States of Micronesia]]
***The [[Federated States of Micronesia]] surpasses 1,000 cases of [[COVID-19]] due a recent increase in the number of new cases. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/micronesias-first-covid-19-outbreak-balloons-causing-alarm-2835816 (CNA)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Indonesia]]
**[[President of Indonesia|President]] [[Joko Widodo]] visits [[China]] for diplomatic talks, formally inviting [[President of the People's Republic of China|President]] [[Xi Jinping]] to the [[G20]] [[2022 G20 Bali summit|summit]] in [[Bali]]. Widodo will also visit [[Japan]] and [[South Korea]] on the trip. [https://apnews.com/article/g-20-summit-travel-china-indonesia-502444b07c48bc0683f3753ecbabf42e (AP News)]
*[[Foreign relations of France]]
**[[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] visits [[Cameroon]] for diplomatic talks to discuss the ongoing [[2022 food crises|food crisis]] and strategies to increase agricultural production. Macron will also visit [[Benin]] and [[Guinea Bissau]] on the trip. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-africa-macron-nigeria-dfbcdeb224d9b9c63ac50f17a6e2dcbe (AP News)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Algeria]]n [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Algeria)|Foreign Minister]] [[Ramtane Lamamra]] indicates support for [[Syria]] to return to the [[Arab League]] after a decade-long suspension. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-syria-bashar-assad-damascus-arab-league-881425710833e22b8a3b1715cade83e3 (AP)]
*[[Philippines–Russia relations]]
**The [[Philippine government]] announces the termination of a [[United States dollar|US$]]227-million deal to procure 16 [[Mil Mi-17]] [[military helicopter]]s from Russia, citing the risk of a potential imposition of [[International sanctions|sanctions]] by the [[United States]] under the [[Countering America's Adversaries Through Sanctions Act]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/ap-exclusive-philippines-scraps-russian-chopper-deal-87474876 (ABC News)]
*[[Mexico]] says that it has reached an agreement with the United States to give a record 356,000 [[work permit|working visas]] to Mexican citizens. [https://pulsoslp.com.mx/nacional/mexicanos-recibiran-un-record-de-356-mil-visas-de-trabajo-de-eeuu-/1520230 (Pulso)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**The [[Special Jurisdiction for Peace]] [[criminal charge|charges]] 19 [[National Army of Colombia|Colombian soldiers]] with [[war crime]]s and [[crimes against humanity]] for the death of 303 people, mostly civilians, between 2005 and 2008. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/26/colombia-peace-tribunal-charges-19-soldiers-for-300-murders (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Capital punishment in Japan]]
**[[Japan]] [[capital punishment|executes]] Tomohiro Katō, perpetrator of the 2008 [[Akihabara massacre]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62301427 (BBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/26/japan-executes-man-over-2008-stabbing-rampage-reports (Al Jazeera)]
